name: approval-decision
description: Evaluate whether a request should be approved, denied, or requires further review based on policy

options.description: Request meets all policy requirements and can proceed without further review
Request violates policy or has clear blocking issues that prevent approval
Request requires additional human review due to ambiguity, edge cases, or policy exceptions

evaluation_factors: Clarity and completeness of the request
Precedent and consistency with prior decisions

metadata.purpose: Bounded approval decisions via JEV semantic matching
